topic: Adding facility name and real locations
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed data tracking requirements. It was confirmed that the `device_trusted` metric refers to local trusted devices.

Regarding location data, a request was made to include the facility name in the tracking and to add an additional real-world location that does not involve a cruise terminal and has been active for at least two weeks. The need for the facility name prompted a discussion about reissuing the data set if required.

Ultimately, the requested updates were completed.
decisions: The `device_trusted` metric was confirmed to refer to local trusted devices.
action_items: Someone updated the tracking data with the facility name and added an additional real-world location.
